responses:
Ang RA 9344 ay batas na tumutulong sa mga batang may kaso.

• Hindi agad pinaparusahan ang bata
• Tinutulungan muna siyang magbago
• Naniniwala itong may pagkakataon pa ang bawat bata
responses_en:
RA 9344 is a law that helps children who get into trouble.

• It doesn't punish right away
• It helps the child change first
• It believes every child deserves a second chance

responses:
Depende sa edad mo ang mangyayari:

• 15 taong gulang pababa — hindi ka mananagot sa krimen, tutulungan ka lang
• 16-17 taong gulang at alam mong mali ang ginawa — may proseso na tinatawag na diversion

Sa lahat ng edad, tulong ang layunin, hindi parusa.
responses_en:
It depends on your age:

• 15 years old or younger — you won't be held responsible, you'll just be helped
• 16-17 years old and you knew it was wrong — there's a process called diversion

At every age, the goal is to help, not to punish.

responses:
Ang discernment ay kung alam mo bang mali o tama ang ginawa mo noong panahong 'yon.

Titingnan ito ng social worker base sa:
• edad mo
• sitwasyon
• antas ng pag-unawa mo
responses_en:
Discernment just means: did you know, at the time, that what you did was right or wrong?

A social worker looks at:
• your age
• the situation
• how much you understood

responses:
Ang diversion ay parang usapan, hindi kaso sa korte.

• Kausap mo ang barangay o social worker
• Sama-sama ninyong aayusin ang nangyari
• Layunin: maintindihan mo ang ginawa mo at hindi na ito maulit
responses_en:
Diversion is like a talk, instead of a court case.

• You meet with the barangay or a social worker
• Together you work things out
• The goal: you understand what happened, and it doesn't happen again

examples_en: what is an intervention program
how does intervention work
who goes through intervention
responses:
Ang intervention ay tulong na ibinibigay sa mga batang 15 pababa.

• Hindi ka managot sa krimen
• May counseling at tulong sa pag-aaral
• May suporta mula sa iyong pamilya
responses_en:
Intervention is help given to children 15 and younger.

• You won't face criminal charges
• You get counseling and learning support
• Your family helps too

responses:
May mga karapatan ka bilang bata:

• Pwede kang manahimik hangga't wala kang abogado
• Pwede mong tawagan ang magulang mo
• Hindi ka dapat isama sa mga matatanda kung ikukulong

responses_en:
You have rights as a child:

• You can stay silent until you have a lawyer
• You can call your parent
• You shouldn't be placed with adults if detained
• You should be treated with respect

You are not alone in this.

responses:
Maraming pwede mong lapitan:

• Ang barangay mo
• Ang social worker (LSWDO)
• Abogado mula sa PAO (libre)
• Bahay Pag-asa, kung kailangan mo ng matutuluyan

Karaniwan, sa barangay muna nagsisimula ang tulong.
responses_en:
Lots of people can help you:

• Your barangay
• A social worker (LSWDO)
• A free lawyer from PAO
• Bahay Pag-asa, if you need a safe place to stay

Help usually starts at the barangay.

responses:

examples: ikukulong ba ako kasama ng matatanda
examples_en: will i go to jail
can i be imprisoned

what is my punishment
will i be locked up
will i be jailed with adults
responses:
Hindi ka basta-basta makukulong.

• 15 taong gulang pababa — hindi ka ikukulong, tutulungan ka lang (intervention)
• 16-17 na may discernment — dumadaan sa diversion, hindi tuwirang kulungan
• Kung kailangan ng ligtas na matutuluyan, sa Bahay Pag-asa ka dadalhin, hindi sa regular na kulungan, at hindi ka isasama sa mga matatandang bilanggo

Ang layunin ng batas: tulungan ka, hindi ikulong.
responses_en:
You won't just be thrown in jail.

• 15 years old or younger — you won't be jailed, you'll just be helped (intervention)
• 16-17 with discernment — you go through diversion, not straight to jail
• If you need a safe place to stay, you'd go to Bahay Pag-asa, not a regular jail, and you won't be placed with adult inmates

The goal of the law is to help you, not to lock you up.
